summary: Seven consecutive Kaggle benchmark task creations failed with KERNEL_WITHOUT_RUN ('notebook completed but did not produce any run output') because build artifacts were written into /kaggle/working, which Kaggle uploads as notebook output.
root_cause: The Node.js tarball (~31 MB), its extraction (~100 MB), node_modules and the cloned repo were all created under /kaggle/working. Kaggle uploads that directory as the notebook's run output; exceeding the practical output budget makes the upload fail, so kbench records no run at all. The run status is reported only as KERNEL_WITHOUT_RUN with no log and no traceback, because a rejected creation exposes no run from which to read logs.
what_i_did_wrong: Assumed KERNEL_WITHOUT_RUN meant a wall-clock timeout and spent four pushes varying BUDGET (150s, 90s, 75s) instead of testing the output-artifact hypothesis first.

Wrapped the .run() call in try/except, which would have swallowed any real exception and left only the same opaque KERNEL_WITHOUT_RUN symptom; error-surfacing should have been the first change, not the sixth.
Had no cheap control experiment until attempt 8: a pure time.sleep(75) task that completed proved wall-clock was not the limit, and only then was the artifact-location hypothesis tested.

Attempted to delegate the initial codebase recon and the Kaggle capability research; all 7 specialist dispatches failed with 'Session too large to compact', so the reconnaissance had to be redone inline after the fact.
diagnosis_method: Bisected structure vs duration: phase-probe (structure identical, no heavy work) created successfully; sleep-probe (75 s of pure sleep) created successfully; only tasks writing large artifacts into /kaggle/working failed. Moving the build to tempfile.gettempdir()/kronos and redirecting child stdout/stderr to files (avoiding pipe-hold hangs on process-group kill) fixed it on the first retry.
correct_procedure: Never write build output, node_modules, clone directories or archives into /kaggle/working; use /tmp (≈1.1 TB free, not uploaded).
Write only the small result JSON into /kaggle/working so it can be downloaded with `kaggle b t download`.

Run subprocesses with stdout/stderr redirected to temp files and start_new_session=True plus os.killpg on timeout; subprocess.run(capture_output=True, timeout=...) can hang when grandchildren hold the pipes.
Before diagnosing an opaque benchmark failure, push a minimal control task: a successful control distinguishes 'the environment is broken' from 'my task is broken' in about two minutes.
Judge runs by their assertion payload and output files, never by the run status line.

evidence.failed_versions: baseline-kronos-suite v2, v3, v4, v5, v6, v7 (KERNEL_WITHOUT_RUN)
evidence.first_success_after_fix: baseline-kronos-suite v8, run 4072644, Completed, 29.5 s total
evidence.baseline_result: tsc --noEmit rc=2 (5 x TS2307 in src/sectors/deers-rock-adapter.ts for undeclared sibling repo ../../../Deers-Rock/dist); vitest rc=1, 6 failed / 30 passed of 36 test files
